preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 40 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length n is an integer between 1 and 40 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for n, s in zip(ns, ss))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string s has length n and consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k, n in zip(results, ns))
postconditions.description: Each output k is an integer between 0 and the corresponding string length n.

postconditions.expression: all(min_k(n, s) == k for k, n, s in zip(results, ns, ss))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output k is the minimum number of characters to select and permute such that the resulting string is sorted alphabetically, where min_k(n, s) is defined as the smallest k for which there exists a subset of indices of size k whose characters can be rearranged to fill those positions while leaving the other n-k characters fixed, resulting in a string equal to the sorted version of s.
